decisions.cancel_condition: Cancel if unfilled at valid_until, if any completed H1 candle closes below 1.12250 before entry, or if a high-impact EUR/USD event becomes imminent within 60 minutes before fill.
decisions.exposure_note: Adds 0.25% EUR-long/USD-short risk. The prior USDCAD BUY_LIMIT traded through its entry zone during the completed 07:00 UTC bar and is therefore treated as potentially active; if active, the two positions offset USD directionally, leaving 0.25% EUR-long and 0.25% CAD-short exposure. Existing account and duplicate-symbol risk remain subject to server-side enforcement.
decisions.reasoning: EURUSD completed the 07:00 UTC H1 candle at 1.12409, 9.8 pips above the prior 20-bar high of 1.12311. The candle had a 30.6-pip body, closed near its high, and retained a tight 0.4-pip closing spread. The 1.12290 limit seeks a retest of the broken range instead of chasing a roughly 3-ATR impulse; the stop invalidates a deeper failed breakout and the target provides approximately 2.50R.

message: TRADE: EURUSD.x BUY_LIMIT breakout-retest setup selected from a complete fresh 18/18-symbol scan; 0.25% proposed risk, approximately 2.50R, and no market chase.
